main.remarks: Immutable signing input model supplied to access-key signers.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an empty access-key signature signing context.

property.name: AccessKeyRealmID
property.summary: Current access-key realm identifier for the signing operation.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Optional logger available to the configured signer for diagnostics.

property.name: ManifestHash
property.summary: Current manifest hash associated with the key being issued.

property.name: SignatureInfo
property.summary: Resolved signing metadata for the current signing operation. This may be the default value during signing-info discovery.

property.name: SignedRegion
property.summary: Canonical signed-region bytes for the current signing operation. This may be empty during signing-info discovery.

property.name: SignerAccessManagerID
property.summary: Access-manager identifier that will be written into the outer signer metadata.

property.name: SignerToolID
property.summary: Tool identifier that will be written into the outer signer metadata.

property.name: Subject
property.summary: Subject for the key being issued.

property.name: ToolSchemaID
property.summary: Current tool schema identifier for the signing operation.
